earlier_sources: https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg at 52f780bc9d197280a9f430574e179a5f233c56b6, ofl/ptserif/src/: ParaType's own builds of PT Serif Caption (PTZ55F.ttf, PTZ56F.ttf and their web formats) beside PT Serif's; no source. google/fonts has no source block for this family.
disclose: The releases kern through a GPOS kern feature and also carry a legacy `kern` table (20694 to 20882 pairs per style). Shapers read the GPOS feature, which these sources keep; the legacy table, read only by software without GPOS support, is not carried.

The released fonts are hinted (TrueType instructions). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the releases', its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
